            --accent-orange: #ff8c42;
            --cyan-glow: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.3);
            --magenta-glow: rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.25);
            --cyan-dim: #0a3d33;
            --magenta-dim: #3d0a2e;

            --font-display: 'Clash Display', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Satoshi', sans-serif;

            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.8vw, 2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            --stat-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);

            --slide-padding: clamp(1.2rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */

        /* 1. Lock html/body to viewport */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* 2. Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* 3. Content container with flex for centering */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        /* 4. ALL typography uses clamp() for responsive scaling */
        :root {
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.2rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        /* 5. Cards/containers use viewport-relative max sizes */
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        /* 6. Lists auto-scale with viewport */
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* 7. Grids adapt to available space */
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* 8. Images constrained to viewport */
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Short viewports (< 700px height) */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        /* Very short viewports (< 600px height) */
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        /* Extremely short (< 500px height) */
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        /* Narrow viewports (< 600px width) */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root {
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem);
            }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REDUCED MOTION
           =========================================== */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

        /* ===========================================
           GRID BACKGROUND PATTERN
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* Neon glow pulse */
        @keyframes neonPulse {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--cyan-glow), 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--cyan-glow), 0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15); }
        }

        @keyframes barGrow {
            from { transform: scaleY(0); }
            to { transform: scaleY(1); }
        }

        @keyframes hBarGrow {
            from { transform: scaleX(0); }
            to { transform: scaleX(1); }
        }

        @keyframes lineDrawIn {
            from { stroke-dashoffset: 2000; }
            to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE-SPECIFIC STYLES
           =========================================== */

        /* --- Progress Bar --- */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-magenta));
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* --- Navigation Dots --- */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 10px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--cyan-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* --- Slide Number --- */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .slide-number span { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* --- Title Slide --- */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%, rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-cyan), #ffffff 40%, var(--accent-magenta));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
            max-width: min(80vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        }

        .title-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-stat {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-stat .val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .title-stat .label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }

        /* --- Section Title --- */
        .section-title {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .section-title .accent { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .section-title .accent-m { color: var(--accent-magenta); }

        .section-subtitle {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* --- Card Styles --- */
        .data-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .data-card.cyan-border { border-color: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.25); }
        .data-card.magenta-border { border-color: rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.25); }

        /* --- Stat Display --- */
        .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--stat-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-value.magenta { color: var(--accent-magenta); }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(2px, 0.4vw, 6px);
        }

        /* --- Chart Containers --- */
        .chart-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* --- Bar Chart (Slide 2) --- */
        .waterfall-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            height: clamp(20vh, 30vh, 35vh);
            padding-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            max-width: min(200px, 30vw);
        }

        .bar-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .bar {
            width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 100px);
            border-radius: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 6px) clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 6px) 0 0;
            transform-origin: bottom;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar { animation: barGrow 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards; }

        .bar.cyan-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.5));
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--cyan-glow);
        }

        .bar.magenta-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-magenta), rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.5));
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--magenta-glow);
        }

        .bar.net-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-orange), rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.5));
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.25);
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(4px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* --- Ratio Callout --- */
        .ratio-callout {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.4);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            background: rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.08);
        }

        .ratio-callout .val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
        }

        .ratio-callout .lbl {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* --- Gauge Chart (Slide 3) --- */
        .gauge-container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(80vw, 700px);
        }

        .gauge-track {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 14px);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
            border-radius: 99px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .gauge-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 99px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-blue));
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan-glow);
            transform-origin: left;
        }

        .slide.visible .gauge-fill {
            animation: hBarGrow 1s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        .gauge-marker {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(-1 * clamp(12px, 2vw, 24px));
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .gauge-marker .dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .gauge-marker .glabel {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .gauge-equilibrium {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(clamp(14px, 2vw, 28px));
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .gauge-equilibrium .dashed {
            width: 2px;
            height: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
            background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent-magenta) 0, var(--accent-magenta) 4px, transparent 4px, transparent 8px);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .gauge-equilibrium .elabel {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* --- Horizontal Bar Chart (Slide 4) --- */
        .hbar-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .hbar-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .hbar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: clamp(60px, 12vw, 120px);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .hbar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(10px, 1.4vw, 18px);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.06);
            border-radius: 99px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 99px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.6));
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--cyan-glow);
            transform-origin: left;
        }

        .slide.visible .hbar-fill {
            animation: hBarGrow 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        .hbar-fill.magenta-fill {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-magenta), rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.6));
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--magenta-glow);
        }

        .hbar-val {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* --- Donut Chart (Slide 5) --- */
        .donut-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .donut-svg {
            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 200px);
            height: clamp(120px, 18vw, 200px);
        }

        .donut-center-text {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.3rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            fill: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .donut-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .legend-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* --- Line Chart (Slide 6) --- */
        .line-chart-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(85vw, 750px);
        }

        .line-chart-svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
        }

        .slide.visible .chart-line {
            animation: lineDrawIn 2s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        /* --- Pie/Stacked Bar (Slide 7) --- */
        .tvs-layout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .tvs-chart-col {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
        }

        .tvs-data-col {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: clamp(200px, 40vw, 400px);
        }

        .tvs-pie-svg {
            width: clamp(130px, 16vw, 190px);
            height: clamp(130px, 16vw, 190px);
        }

        .flippening-bars {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .flip-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .flip-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 60px);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .flip-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.06);
            border-radius: 99px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .flip-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 99px;
            transform-origin: left;
        }

        .slide.visible .flip-fill {
            animation: hBarGrow 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        .flip-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            width: clamp(45px, 5vw, 60px);
        }

        /* --- Key Takeaways (Slide 8) --- */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px) 0;
        }

        .takeaway-item:nth-child(even) {
            border-left-color: var(--accent-magenta);
        }

        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
            }

            nextSlide() { this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1); }
            prevSlide() { this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1); }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ': case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                        case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(0); break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        diff > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (e.deltaY > 30) this.nextSlide();
                    else if (e.deltaY < -30) this.prevSlide();
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                if (!bar) return;
                this.progressBar = bar;
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotEls) return;
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return server, actual_port


def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"

    try:
        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
        script_file.write_text(script)

        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["node", str(script_file)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=180,
            env=env,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
    finally:
        server.shutdown()

    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
    if not pngs:
        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
    return pngs


def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
    prs = Presentation()
    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches

    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout

    for img_path in slide_images:
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return server, actual_port


def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"

    try:
        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
        script_file.write_text(script)

        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["node", str(script_file)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=180,
            env=env,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
    finally:
        server.shutdown()

    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
    if not pngs:
        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
    return pngs
